answer: Practically, the chain should mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because summit only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice basalt is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any harbor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
